summary: Telefonica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Notice to Shareholders announcing that its Board approved Interest on Capital (IoC, Brazil's dividend-equivalent distribution) of R$450,000,000.00 gross, or R$0.14081834570 per share, subject to 17.5% withholding tax, yielding R$0.11617513520 net per share. The record date is October 26, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC, with payment by April 30, 2027. The distribution counts toward mandatory 2026 dividends, ad referendum of the 2027 annual meeting. Share buybacks may adjust the per-share amount. Watch for buyback-driven revisions and payout timing.
